name: Progressive Null-Tracking with Super-Voxel Grid
definition:
A technique to make null-tracking methods resilient to non-bounding extinctions by progressively estimating and updating spatially varying bounding extinctions ($
u_t$) on a coarse grid during rendering.
summary: Progressive Null-Tracking with Super-Voxel Grid adapts bounding extinctions to local density variations on a coarse grid, ensuring unbiased passes unlike methods with iterative bias.
